projects.name: MongoDB RAG
highlights: Engineered an agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system to automate domain knowledge extraction across 10,000+ documents, evidenced by a 35% reduction in LLM hallucinations, by orchestrating LangChain, local models (vLLM/Ollama), and dynamic prompt synthesis.

Optimized system latency and retrieval relevance for complex queries, achieving a 92% Top-K retrieval precision and reducing p95 query latency to <800ms, by implementing a hybrid search architecture (Full-text + Vector Fusion) with cross-encoder reranking using MongoDB Atlas and Sentence Transformers.

Accelerated the document embedding workflow to handle large-scale data ingestion, demonstrated by processing over 50,000 records per hour without downtime, by designing an automated batch indexing pipeline in Python that detects and processes missing vectors.

Delivered a responsive GenAI user interface for real-time system interaction, reducing manual database management time by 15 hours/week, by deploying a Streamlit application integrated directly with the MongoDB backend to manage search parameters and collection metadata.

projects.name: Vivah.ai — Voice based Matrimonial Application
highlights: Engineered an agentic voice bot for dynamic user onboarding, achieving sub-second conversational latency, by integrating Gemini Live and OpenAI LLMs using the pipecat-ai framework within an asynchronous FastAPI backend.
Implemented real-time GenAI audio streaming with bidirectional WebSockets, asyncio, and thread pools to support scalable concurrent user sessions.
Built a scalable AI deployment pipeline using Docker, AWS ECS (Fargate), and API Gateway for auto-scaling and high availability.
Built an LLM function-calling pipeline to extract structured data from conversations, enforcing Pydantic schemas and storing results in PostgreSQL.

projects.name: Mediflow — Voice controlled Dashboard
highlights: Deployed an agentic, multimodal voice assistant, achieving ultra-low latency for real-time user interactions, by orchestrating Large Language Models (LLMs) via Google GenAI, Silero VAD, and the Pipecat framework.
Developed a FastAPI/Python decision-support microservice processing 50+ data profiles, containerized with Docker for scalable deployment.
Automated OCR-based dashboard data extraction using OpenCV and React, eliminating manual data entry and reducing ingestion latency.
Architected an event-sourced FSM backend with PostgreSQL and SQLAlchemy, ensuring consistent state management across agentic workflows.

experience.company: Siemens Technology and Services Pvt Ltd
highlights: Built a scalable federated learning framework, as considered by successful cross-device model training with zero raw data exchange, by leveraging PyTorch and the Industrial Edge (IIH) SDK to support privacy-preserving distributed learning.

Optimized ML data and training pipelines, as quantified by a ~25% improvement in distributed training throughput, by implementing parallel processing and automated preprocessing workflows for computer vision and time-series applications.

Enhanced global model performance, as assessed by ~20% accuracy gains across object detection and time-series foundation model tasks, by designing advanced aggregation strategies and applying parameter-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA/QLoRA) under strict resource constraints through feature refinement techniques.
Containerized training workflows using Docker for reproducible deployment across heterogeneous CPU/GPU hardware on Siemens Industrial Edge platform.
Training LLMs through RLHF
Prompt evaluation and optimization
